clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope—Requirements regarding material, construction and workmanship, patterns and sizes, dimansions and tolerances and marking for vitreous enamelled steel wash basins.

clauses.title: Material
clauses.text: 2. Material — Mild steel sheet of thickness 1 mm. min.

clauses.title: Patterns and
clauses.text: 3. Patterns and  Sizes Pattern Norminal Size (Overall Length × Overall Width) mm mm i) Flat-back (Type 1) 480 × 430 500 × 450 Flat-back (Type 2) 500 × 450 600 × 500 ii) Flat-rim 480 × 430 500 × 400 510 × 450 530 × 430 iii) Overall 450 × 400 iv) Round 450 Dia

clauses.title: Tolerance – On overall
clauses.text: 3.1 Tolerance - On overall dimension + 2 percent. Note 1— Wash basins may be made in other patterns and sizes where mutually agreed. Note 2 -  For detailed dimensions and figures refer to the standard.

clauses.title: Basin shall have in
clauses.text: 4.1 Basin shall have in integral soap holder recess or recesses which shall drain into the bowl.

clauses.title: A slot type of
clauses.text: 4.2 A slot type of overflow having an area of not less than 500 mm2 shall be provided in the front or back faciloitte cleaning of the overflow.  The cross-sectional area of passageway of overflow shall be 400 mm2, minmum.

clauses.title: Surface Coating
clauses.text: 5. Surface Coating—  Interioirs of wash basins shall be adequately and evenly coated with vitreous enamel of qualityin 5.1 to 5.5 Atleast one ground or primer coating preferably white, or coloured enamel coating shall be applied on the outer surface.

clauses.title: Finish
clauses.text: 5.1 Finish — Gloss, colour and opacity shall be uniform and visually satisfactory.

clauses.title: Abrasion
clauses.text: 5.2 Abrasion — Shall withstand resistance to scratching .

clauses.title: Alkali Aesistance
clauses.text: 5.3 Alkali Aesistance — There shall be no loss in weight.

clauses.title: White enamelled wash basins
clauses.text: 5.4.1 White enamelled wash basins — There shall be no loss in weight.

clauses.title: Coloured enamelled wash basins
clauses.text: 5.4.2 Coloured enamelled wash basins — Shall conform to classes AA,A and B.

clauses.title: Defects
clauses.text: 5.5 Defects — Shall be liable to rejection if finish shows any of the following defects : a) Crazing b) Dimples , rundown and sagging c) Blisters —Not more than two in number on interior surface shall bew permitted provided they cannot be broken by a pressure  of a finger nail. d) Pinholes—maximum 2 for cloloured wash basins and maximum 4 for white enamelled  wash basins permissible.  There shall be no grouping of pinholes and they shall not penetrate to the metal. e) Specks — shall be less than 1 mm in size and maximum 5 in number and there shall be no grouping.

clauses.title: Thickness of
clauses.text: 5.6 Thickness of  Enamel— Minimum 0.2 mm, and maximum 0.5 mm.

clauses.title: Warpage of edges set
clauses.text: 5.7 Warpage of edges set against wall and edges of rol rims shall not exceed 5 mm/m warpage of all other edges shall not exceed 7.5 mm/m. SUMMARY OF IS 8727 : 1978 VITREOUS  ENAMELLED STEEL WASH-BASINS Note — For test procedures refer to IS 772 : 1973 General requirements for enamelled cast iron sanitary appliances(second revision), and IS 3972. Methods of test for vitreous enamel ware. For  detailed information, refer to IS 8727 : 1978 Specification for vitreous   enamelled steel wash-basins.
